neighbours.label: Precious metals (gold, silver, platinum 'Pt', palladium) named as materials, especially in chemistry or materials text; base metals in the same frames (copper, iron, steel, zinc) stay quiet.

quiet: The electrodes were coated with a thin layer of copper.
